title: Patch selected image payloads when the native layout envelope is unchanged
when: Only a diagram mark, label offset, fill opacity or draw order changes; native size/crop/transform and ownership remain valid.
do: Use user delta + selected scene + exact input package + image binding + replacement + relevant prior checks.
Resolve question -> table -> picture control -> binaryItemIDRef -> manifest member -> expected old payload hash.
Require same PNG pixel size and unchanged embedding/ownership; shared media requires a declared local-layout route rather than bypassing the finite patch guard.
Replace only selected media in a new versioned HWPX; require all non-target uncompressed member bytes and order identical.
Check affected native image regions and exact unchanged text/layout evidence; retain prior equation/table/transfer qualification.

Treat dots and arcs as source encodings, label placement as presentation independent of vertex/incidence, and sector fill opacity/layer independently of stroke/image opacity. Paint fill beneath geometry.
Retain the original embedded preview with an explicit stale-preview limit; refreshing it adds a separately declared derived-member edit.
avoid: Do not rerun whole-paper transcription, recreate equations/question tables or regenerate all scenes for this eligible delta.
check: Source/base/output hashes and allowed changed-member list.
Fixed canvas/embedding, unique media references, affected visual features.
If an embedded preview is retained, use fresh native PDF/crops as current evidence.
limitation: v3 package patch was 95.784ms and native export 12406.263ms for one occurrence. Total task time and token savings are unknown. Shared media, size/aspect/crop/owner changes require local-layout routing.
